_comment: JEV model registry — the ONLY models JEV may select (MASTER_STATUS_AND_ROADMAP.md §15: hard restriction to configured pools). NO SECRETS and no model id that is owned elsewhere: a paid Claude entry names a KEY of projects/mythos-ai-executor/config/model-policy.json, a paid OpenAI entry names a ROLE of projects/mythos-orchestrator/config/openai.json, the free pool resolves its models from free-llm/catalog.json, and the local model is whatever the Haddad runtime serves. Tier decides order (DOTS policy models.tier_order: free → local → paid); a paid model is offered only while DOTS permits and budgets it. Adding a model = one entry here plus its pools — never a change to FABLE, DOTS or JEV.

free-llm-pool.note: Meta-model over projects/mythos-ai-executor/free-llm (26 catalogued free-tier services, 9 wired). Its own A→B→C loop tries every keyed free provider before this entry reports failure, so one free provider's outage never reaches JEV.

qwen-local.note: Qwen 2.5 7B on the Haddad GPU (llama-server, 8192-token context). The only model with execution authority on Haddad: repository work runs through the executor daemon's haddad-agent provider (sandboxed tools, measured outcome).

claude-sonnet.note: Paid fallback, first choice: the Claude CLI with tools disabled (answers only). Model id comes from the executor's model-policy catalog.

openai-advisor.note: Paid fallback, second choice: the OpenAI Responses API through mythos-orchestrator/providers/openai.js. Unavailable on a host with no key file — never invented.
